resolvedFindings.title: UTF-8 BOM path alias accepted
resolvedFindings.detail: Default TextDecoder stripped leading BOM from ZIP names; malicious last entry BOM+manifest.json was accepted as manifest.json by readZip and verifyExport while Python zipfile saw a distinct filename. ignoreBOM:true now preserves the character so the exact path allowlist rejects it.
resolvedFindings.independentOracle: Python zipfile.namelist showed BOM-prefixed filename, no manifest.json

independentHostileChecks.scope: Each byte of a valid 1696-byte archive toggled once; 6 extreme length/count/offset fields; trailing bytes and concatenated ZIP

analysis.snapshot: All mutable arrays/media bytes copied before first await; manifest, filenames and review object frozen, each ZIP freshly allocated. Caller mutation covered by test.
analysis.binding: Private copied media and Markdown hashes enter restricted JCS payload digest; semantic timestamp, media/source identity, audio and type conditions checked before hashing. Independent Python ZIP/JCS/hash oracle passes.
analysis.zipResources: At most34entries; aggregate/per-file caps checked before final copies and CRC. Store-only profile refuses compression, encryption, links/attrs, extras/comments, bad offsets, mismatched names, duplicates and extra local bytes. CRC visits bounded file content once; bounded searches over32/34entries are not unbounded quadratic work. Offset/length arithmetic stays within safe JS integers.
